# PhaseLens

> PhaseLens is a free, offline Windows application for powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis: import, background and K-alpha2 handling, peak search, phase identification, quantification and reproducible reports. It never assumes the wavelength, axis or units, and stores every assumption with the result.

PhaseLens is closed source (PhaseLens Closed Beta License v1.0). This repository holds installers, release files, documentation and the update manifest only; there is no application source code.

## Docs

- [Website](https://ameenalzubi0-bit.github.io/PhaseLens-releases/): overview, methods, validation, download.
- [README](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/PhaseLens-releases/blob/main/README.md): features, methods with equations, validation results, known limitations, roadmap, FAQ.
- [Known limitations](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/PhaseLens-releases/blob/main/README.md#known-limitations): stated on purpose.
